verdicts.note: Entry's repro holds at HEAD: all 24 captured phrasings keep their write tools (55 tools, read_only False) and the live llama3.1:8b AUTO runs emit real portfolio_delete_position and write_note tool_use; intent-gate tests 26 passed. The verifier's question-shaped phrasings reproduce in-process (read, signal '?', 42 tools, no writes). Live they fail exactly like the entry's A1: no tool_use, and the model types {"name": "portfolio_update_position", ...} as chat text (2/2). It needs both a read cue and a verb outside the cue table: 'Could you add...?' and 'Please log ...' (no '?') keep the writes. The verifier's two hypotheticals ('What if you drop...?', 'Why not trim...?') are ambiguous and not required.
